newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA HOSTS REGIONAL TRANSPORT CONFERENCE.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA HOSTS REGIONAL TRANSPORT CONFERENCE.

text.p: Transport ministers from the Central European Initiative and the Black Sea Economic Cooperation opened talks in Sofia on Thursday aimed at boosting regional transport links.
Ministers and representatives from 22 countries will spend two days discussing how to link their transport infrastructure to existing trans-European routes and attract investment for development.

"I am convinced that this meeting will develop the efforts of our governments and peoples for peaceful relations between neighbours and...for intensive contacts and increased exchange of information," Bulgarian Prime Minister Zhan Videnov said in his opening speech.

The conference will also discuss establishing a trans-regional centre in Sofia to coordinate efforts to attract investment, promoting countries' economic cooperation and their integration with the European Union.
"The trans-regional centre will also help in attracting investments in the region," said Videnov.
